entries.value: Golden pawns {0}/{1}: finish in par moves or fewer
Every move adds 1 to the count on the track below. The door opens only if you step in on 7.
Use the arrow keys to step onto the glowing space. Every step adds 1 to the counter.
Counter: {0}. The door opens only on step {1}, so follow the glowing space.
Next step is {0}! The door is open: walk in.
Oops! Press Z to undo or R to restart.
New: spikes and flowerpots! They hurt on a normal step, but on a lucky step (7) they can't touch you. Follow the glowing space.
New: dice! A die throws you 1 space, or 6 on a lucky step. Spaces you fly over don't count. Follow the glowing space.
New: holes! Walk into one and you fall, but a dice fling jumps right over it. Follow the glowing space.
New: the black cat! If it crosses your path, the counter goes back to 0. Gold paws show where it goes next.
New: coin bridges! On any lucky step, every bridge on the board opens for good. Follow the glowing space.
New: the broken mirror! It makes the counter count down. At 0 it counts up again. Follow the glowing space.
A new land! Here 8 is lucky, any number with a 4 kills, and 13 is harmless. You start at 5.
New: wood! Knock on wood: a step onto a wooden space does not count. Follow the glowing space.
New: the evil-eye bead! Pick it up and it saves you from bad luck once, but not from a fall. Follow the glowing space.
Step {0} is lucky! Step onto the glowing space.
They hurt on a normal step. On a lucky step they pull back.
Step under it on a normal step and it lands on you. On a lucky step it misses.
Flings you 1 space, or 6 on a lucky step. Spaces you fly over do not count.
Any lucky step opens every bridge for good. While it is closed, you fall.
Walk into it and you fall. A dice fling jumps right over it.
When it crosses your path the counter goes back to 0: a second shot at 7. The gold paw print shows its next space.
Step on it and the counter counts down. At 0 it counts up again.
Knock on wood: stepping onto a wooden space does not count.
Pick it up and it saves you from bad luck once, but not from a fall.
All levels done! More worlds are on the way.
Every board begins with a single step, and the seventh is the one that opens the door.
Something furry crosses your path, and the count starts over.
Here the numbers run backwards, and luck waits at the other end of the glass.
Eight is the lucky number here, and four is never welcome.
Knock on wood and the step does not count. Carry a blue bead and bad luck passes you by.
